description: `true` for 2xx statuses. `fetch` resolves for 404 and 500 too; only missing responses reject.
A signal that aborts after `ms`. Pass it to `fetch` so a slow upstream cannot hold your request forever.
Your server, acting as a gateway, got an invalid or failed response from a dependency.
A dependency did not answer within your deadline.
Translating upstream failures into your own error type and status codes at the boundary, without leaking upstream bodies.
A slow dependency without timeouts ties up your requests until your service fails too.
Stops calling a dependency that keeps failing and fails fast for a while, giving it time to recover.
